gloss: rocky area; rocky place; rocky terrain

definitions.gloss: rocky area; rocky place; rocky terrain
definitions.explanation: An area of ground, coastline, or mountain that is covered with large rocks or rock formations. Often used in the context of climbing, hiking, or fishing.

examples.english: I fished from the rocky area.

examples.japanese: {岩場|いわば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{滑|すべ}りやすい→滑りやすい：27611_suberiyasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The rocky area is slippery, so please be careful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な{岩場|いわば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Climbing steep rocky terrain requires specialized equipment.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧ (rock) + ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ (place), with ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧ voicing to ば in this compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {岩場|いわば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb a rocky area
- {岩場|いわば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fish from rocks
- ⟦{険|けわ}しい→険しい：08154_kewashii⟧{岩場|いわば}: steep rocky terrain
- {岩場|いわば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれた→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧: rocky coastline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{岩肌|いわはだ}→岩肌：27479_iwahada⟧: rock face — the exposed surface of a rock, not an area
- ⟦{岩礁|がんしょう}→岩礁：24550_ganshou⟧: reef; rocky shoal — submerged or partially submerged rocks in the sea
- ⟦{磯|いそ}→磯：05389_iso⟧: rocky beach — specifically a rocky shoreline
